import sys,os,json,time,hashlib,pathlib,gc
sys.path.insert(0,'/source/sllm_store')
import torch
from vllm import LLM,SamplingParams
ref=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/control/reference.json').read_text())
import sllm_store._C as extension
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(extension.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==ref['extension_sha256']
model_path='/store/vllm/'+ref['model_alias'];assert json.loads(pathlib.Path(model_path+'/generation_config.json').read_text())['eos_token_id']==163586
llm=LLM(model=model_path,**ref['restore_kwargs'])
print('RESTORE_MODEL_READY '+json.dumps({'monotonic':time.monotonic()}),flush=True)
end=time.monotonic()+120
while not pathlib.Path('/control/ownership-verified.json').exists():
 assert time.monotonic()<end;time.sleep(.05)
def inspect_model(model):
 import torch,json,pathlib,hashlib,os
 from vllm.distributed import get_tensor_model_parallel_rank
 from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.sllm_loader import ServerlessLLMLoader
 ref=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/control/reference.json').read_text());rank=get_tensor_model_parallel_rank();expected=ref['metadata'];state=ServerlessLLMLoader._filter_subtensors(model.state_dict());assert set(state)==set(expected)
 metadata={name:[list(t.shape),list(t.stride()),str(t.dtype),t.numel()*t.element_size()] for name,t in state.items()};assert metadata==expected
 assert sum(t.numel()==0 for t in state.values())==240 and all(t.is_cuda for t in state.values())
 checked=[];count=0
 for item in ref['ranks'][rank]['samples']:
  t=state[item['name']];assert str(t.dtype)==item['dtype'] and t.is_contiguous()
  raw=t.view(torch.uint8).reshape(-1)[item['offset']:item['offset']+item['bytes']].cpu().numpy().tobytes();assert len(raw)==item['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item['sha256'];count+=len(raw);checked.append(item)
 assert count==26112
 params=dict(model.named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False));buffers=dict(model.named_buffers(remove_duplicate=False));bindings={**params,**buffers};assert set(state)<=set(bindings)
 aliases={}
 for name,t in bindings.items():aliases.setdefault(id(t),[]).append(name)
 attributes={name:{'class':type(t).__module__+'.'+type(t).__qualname__,'weight_loader_present':hasattr(t,'weight_loader')} for name,t in bindings.items() if name in state}
 for suffix in ref['empty_suffixes']:
  t=state[ref['prefix']+suffix];assert list(t.shape)==[384,0] and list(t.stride())==[1,1] and t.dtype==torch.int32 and t.numel()==0
 uuid=str(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(torch.cuda.current_device()).uuid);uuid=uuid if uuid.startswith('GPU-') else 'GPU-'+uuid;assert uuid==ref['gpu_uuids'][rank]
 torch.cuda.synchronize();free,total=torch.cuda.mem_get_info();mem={'allocated':torch.cuda.memory_allocated(),'reserved':torch.cuda.memory_reserved(),'peak_allocated':torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),'peak_reserved':torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),'driver_free':free,'driver_total':total};assert all(mem[k]<=131072*(1<<20) for k in ('peak_allocated','peak_reserved')) and total-free<=131072*(1<<20)
 return {'rank':rank,'pid':os.getpid(),'uuid':uuid,'metadata':metadata,'checked_bytes':count,'samples':checked,'parameter_attributes':attributes,'parameter_alias_groups':sorted(sorted(v) for v in aliases.values() if len(v)>1),'memory':mem,'scope':'allfilteredpersistent metadata/26112B values; attrs/aliases observed, notcrossrun numericID proof'}
rows=llm.apply_model(inspect_model);assert len(rows)==8 and {v['rank'] for v in rows}==set(range(8));print('RESTORE_INSPECTION_PASS '+json.dumps(rows),flush=True)
for i,gold in enumerate(ref['gold']):
 out=llm.generate([{'prompt_token_ids':gold['prompt_token_ids']}],SamplingParams(temperature=0,top_p=1,seed=0,n=1,max_tokens=32),use_tqdm=False);assert len(out)==1 and out[0].prompt_token_ids==gold['prompt_token_ids'] and len(out[0].outputs)==1
 value=out[0].outputs[0];assert list(value.token_ids)==gold['token_ids'] and value.text==gold['content'] and value.finish_reason=='stop' and value.stop_reason is None and list(value.token_ids)[-1]==163586
 derived_usage={'prompt_tokens':len(out[0].prompt_token_ids),'completion_tokens':len(value.token_ids),'total_tokens':len(out[0].prompt_token_ids)+len(value.token_ids)};assert derived_usage==gold['frozen_api_usage']
 print('RESTORE_AAB_RESPONSE '+json.dumps({'derived_usage':derived_usage,'usage_scope':'counts derived from actualIDs, notnativeAPIusage object','index':i,'prompt_token_ids':out[0].prompt_token_ids,'token_ids':list(value.token_ids),'text':value.text,'finish_reason':value.finish_reason,'stop_reason':value.stop_reason}),flush=True)
print('RESTORE_AAB_PASS '+json.dumps({'monotonic':time.monotonic(),'requests':3}),flush=True)
del llm;gc.collect()
